title: Goldspire Logistics
kicker: A forgettable freight-coordination concern with plain grey seals and paperwork nobody remembers seeing twice.
hook: Goldspire Logistics: a dull freight mark, a grey seal, and a name too boring to remember.

blocks.label: Public Face
blocks.body: A forgettable freight-coordination concern with plain grey seals and paperwork nobody remembers seeing twice.

blocks.label: How To Deal
blocks.body: Goldspire Logistics does not look powerful. That is the trick of it. A grey seal appears on crate corners, approval slips, and route papers, always in the same modest ink, always small enough to miss if you are looking for a villain with a banner.

affordances: Compare their slogan to what they actually do in the scene.
